name: homemixer
title: homemixer
blurb: a real, subscribable Bluesky feed generator porting the pipeline shape (not the trained model — no ML here) behind github.com/twitter/the-algorithm's home-mixer: live candidate sourcing over your follow graph, a heavy-ranker-style weighted engagement formula, in-network/out-of-network mixing, nothing stored. @skeet.best asked for the port; @bisks.net gave the go-ahead.
